caption_used: Token co-occurrence distributions for the word "reaction" in chemistry (a) and mathematics (b) domains. In the chemistry domain (a), the distribution spans six tokens: "the" dominates at 31%, followed by "this" at 21%, "for" at 17%, "chemical" at 15%, "to" at 9%, and "in" at 7%, with "chemical" and "for" together comprising approximately 28% of co-occurrences. In the mathematics domain (b), co-occurrence is concentrated among four tokens: "the" at 38%, "$" at 19%, "equilibrium" at 27%, and "constant" at 15%. Notably, the mathematics distribution shows greater concentration in fewer tokens, with "the" alone representing a larger share than in the chemistry domain. The combined share of "equilibrium" and "constant" in mathematics (34%) closely mirrors the combined share of "this" and "for" in chemistry (38%), suggesting comparable secondary-token distributions across domains.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: Фигурата съдържа две кръгови (pie) диаграми, означени като (a) и (b), които показват разпределения на съвместна поява на токени за думата „reaction“ в два домейна; и двете диаграми имат легенда над кръга и процентни етикети около секторите, без визуално „издърпани“ (exploded) сегменти. В (a) (химия) са показани общо 6 категории: „the“ (син сектор с диагонални щрихи) 31%, „this“ (син сектор с хоризонтални линии) 21%, „for“ (зелен сектор с кръстосана щриховка) 17%, „chemical“ (светлозелен сектор с точкова/решетъчна текстура) 15%, „to“ (жълт сектор с вълнообразна/зигзагообразна текстура) 9% и „in“ (светлосин сектор с вертикални линии) 7%. В (b) (математика) са показани общо 4 категории: „the“ (син сектор с диагонални щрихи) 38%, „equilibrium“ (червеникав сектор с точкова текстура) 27%, „$“ (жълт сектор с вълнообразна/зигзагообразна текстура) 19% и „consatant“ (сив сектор с точкова текстура) 15%; секторите изглеждат подредени около кръга без явно сортиране по големина.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The figure contains two side-by-side pie charts labeled (a) and (b) that show token co-occurrence distributions for the word “reaction” in two domains, with percentage values printed outside the slices and legends above each pie mapping colors/patterns to token labels. Chart (a) (chemistry) has six slices: “the” in blue with diagonal hatching at about 31%, “this” in light blue with horizontal striping at about 21%, “for” in green with crosshatch at about 17%, “chemical” in pale green with dotted/mesh pattern at about 15%, “to” in yellow with wavy hatching at about 9%, and “in” in very light blue with vertical striping at about 7%; the slices appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller around the circle. Chart (b) (mathematics) has four slices: “the” in blue with diagonal hatching at about 38%, “$” in pink/red with dotted pattern at about 27%, “equilibrium” in yellow with wavy hatching at about 19%, and “consatant” (as spelled in the legend) in gray with dotted pattern at about 15%; percentages are similarly shown outside the slices, and no slices are exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond color/pattern differences.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Die Abbildung zeigt zwei Kreisdiagramme (a) und (b), die die Token-Kookkurrenzverteilungen zum Wort „reaction“ in zwei Domänen darstellen: Chemie (a) und Mathematik (b). Diagramm (a) enthält sechs Segmente mit Prozentangaben an den Segmenten; die Segmente sind über eine Legende oberhalb zugeordnet und farblich bzw. durch Schraffuren unterscheidbar: „the“ (blau, diagonal schraffiert) ca. 31%, „this“ (blau, horizontal schraffiert) ca. 21%, „for“ (grün, kreuzschraffiert) ca. 17%, „chemical“ (hellgrün, punkt-/kreuzschraffiert) ca. 15%, „to“ (gelb, schraffiert) ca. 9% und „in“ (hellblau, vertikal schraffiert) ca. 7%. Diagramm (b) enthält vier Segmente, ebenfalls mit Prozentangaben und Legende oberhalb: „the“ (blau, diagonal schraffiert) ca. 38%, „$“ (rot, schraffiert) ca. 27%, „equilibrium“ (gelb, schraffiert) ca. 19% und „consatant“ (grau, gepunktet) ca. 15%. Es sind keine Segmente hervorgehoben (z. B. herausgezogen), und die Anordnung der Segmente folgt keiner explizit angegebenen Sortierung.
